content.text: No non-compete binds AbbVie anywhere in the agreement. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: 5.8.1 Harpoon shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to (a) directly or indirectly, develop, commercialize or otherwise exploit any Competing Product in any country or other jurisdiction in the Territory, or (b) license, authorize, appoint, or otherwise enable any Third Party to directly or indirectly, develop, commercialize or otherwise exploit any Competing Product in any country or other jurisdiction in the Territory, except, in each case ((a) and (b)), as otherwise expressly provided in this Agreement.
input.rationale: The only non-compete in the Agreement is Section 5.8 ("Exclusivity with Respect to the Territory"), and it runs exclusively against Harpoon and its Affiliates (p0368), with Section 5.6.1 confirming Harpoon's retained rights are "subject to Section 5.8" and Section 7 referring to "in the case of Harpoon, its exclusivity obligations hereunder". That restriction benefits us as Customer/Licensee and is not flagged. The Section 5.8.2 Acquisition / Change in Control carve-outs (p0369) likewise relieve Harpoon, not AbbVie. Searches for restrictions binding AbbVie ("AbbVie shall not", compete, field-of-use, exclusivity) returned no covenant limiting the businesses AbbVie may operate or the products it may buy, develop or sell; the "in the Field in the Territory" language in Section 5.1.3 is a scope limit on the licence granted to us, not a restrictive covenant on our own activities. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no redline is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
